summary: SOL Strategies Inc., a Toronto-based digital asset infrastructure firm listed on the CSE (HODL) and Nasdaq (STKE), furnished a Form 6-K with a November 5, 2026 news release announcing conference participation and an IR engagement rather than a transaction. Management will attend the Cantor Convergence crypto/fintech conference in Miami Beach November 10-12 and Solana Breakpoint 2026 in London November 15-17, hosting a booth with its Houdini Swap team and sponsoring the Block Zero validator summit. The company also engaged KCSA Strategic Communications for investor relations effective November 1, 2026, for an initial four-month term. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors or regulatory clocks are disclosed; the filing is routine investor-communications disclosure with no special-situations or risk-arb angle.
